# Copilot instructions for terraform-provider-msgraph

Before doing any AI-assisted work in this repository, read and follow the repo AI usage policy skill:

- `.github/skills/ai-usage-policy.md`

The skill is mandatory for agents whenever a task involves code edits, command execution, data handling, tool/MCP use, PR preparation, repo automation, workflows, protected files, or any other side-effecting action.

In particular:

- Do not process or repeat secrets, credentials, tokens, connection strings, customer data, access-control data, or regulated data.
- Use only approved tools and MCP servers documented by the repo.
- Do not enable YOLO mode, auto-approve mode, protected-branch bypass, unattended production writes, or gate weakening.
- For side-effecting actions, present the exact diff or command and require explicit human approval.
- For AI-assisted PRs, disclose AI use, name the human owner, record validation evidence, and apply the appropriate AI label.

If this file conflicts with `.github/skills/ai-usage-policy.md` or binding Microsoft source guidance, the stricter rule applies.
